relationships.subject: MK-801
relationships.evidence_quote: blocking the glutamate NMDARs in FHM1 mice (i) prevented CSD initiation at threshold stimulation

relationships.subject: NMDA receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: A delayed activation of NMDARs above a critical threshold level is necessary for CSD initiation in FHM1 mice.

relationships.subject: CaV2.1 channel
relationships.evidence_quote: While, no matter the intensity of stimulation, Ca<sub>V</sub> channels are necessary for CSD initiation

key_findings: FHM1 mice reach the same critical NMDAR activation threshold for CSD initiation as WT, but with lower stimulus intensity and faster
In FHM1 but not WT mice, very strong stimuli can initiate slowly propagating CSDs independent of NMDARs, still requiring CaV channels
